analysis.purpose: The Python tokenizer: a hand-rolled, zero-dependency lexer for the subset the symbol graph needs, written to keep cold install offline, pure-JavaScript and deterministic.
responsibilities: Turn source text into the token stream the structural parser consumes
Degrade a lexing anomaly into a generic token instead of throwing
Emit an indentation-aware INDENT/DEDENT stream so the parser sees block structure directly
Distinguish a significant logical-line break from a non-significant one inside brackets

businessRules.rule: The lexer never throws — an anomaly degrades to a generic token and lexing continues.
businessRules.rationale: Lets the extractor fall back to a file node rather than aborting the whole pipeline.

businessRules.rule: Block structure is emitted as explicit indent and dedent tokens rather than re-derived by the parser.
businessRules.rationale: Indentation is Python syntax; deriving it twice would let the two views disagree.

edges.rationale: This file is the Python lexer.
